items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: I played with Charlie Love too.

ctx.x: There's one other thing that Dick Allen had here on a note. Something about when we interviewed Charlie Love, we interviewed him a couple of times.
I played with Charlie Love too. Yeah, he made it.
I'm going to draw this door. Pardon me just a minute, Eddie. I'll be with you in a little while.
